question: Who among the following is the brand ambassador of Uttarakhand’s Department of Women Empowerment and Child Development as of August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vandana Katariya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vandana Katariya**

 
 
• Vandana Katariya, an Indian field** hockey player**, has become the country's first female to score a **hat-trick** at Olympics.
 
• India defeated** South Africa 4-3** in the women’s hockey pool A match on July 31, 2021.
 
• She had won the** player of the tournament** award in the** Asian Champion Trophy, 2018 **wherein India won a silver medal.
 
• She was also part of the **2016** Rio Olympics. 
 
• She was also made the brand ambassador of the central government’s ‘**Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao**’ scheme for the **Haridwar **districts.
 
• On the occasion of the **Tilu Rauteli Samman** ceremony, State Women Empowerment **Rekha Arya** appointed Vandana Kataria as the brand ambassador.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mary Com**

 
 
• Mary Kom is an Indian **boxer** from the northeast state of **Manipur**.
 
• She is also known as MC Mary Kom or** Magnificent Mary**.
 
• Mary Kom is famed as a **five-time** World Boxing Champion.
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu**
 
 
• ​She is the first Indian woman to win an **Olympic silver** medal.
 
• She is an India **Badminton** player from Hyderabad, Telangana.
 
 
 
• **Mirabai Chanu**
 
 
• Sykhom Mirabai Chanu is from **Manipur**.
 
• She was awarded the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna** award by the Government of India for the year **2018**
 
• Mira bai Chanu also known as "**Saikhom Mirabai Chanu**" won the gold medal in 2017 at the World **Weightlifting** Championships in **Anaheim** (**United States of America**).
